title: ‘Alito’ Invokes the Idea of an Invasion from the US to Save Himself and Revive the PRI
author: Álvaro Delgado Gómez
content:
_This article by Álvaro Delgado Gómez originally appeared in the[August 11,
2026 edition of SinEmbargo](https://www.sinembargo.mx/4852462/alito-invoca-la-
idea-de-una-invasion-desde-eu-para-salvarse-el-y-revivir-al-pri/)._

**Mexico City, August 11 (SinEmbargo).—** Once again, as he has done on
several occasions since Donald Trump took office, the president of the
Institutional Revolutionary Party (PRI), Alejandro Moreno Cárdenas, "Alito,"
requested the intervention of the United States government in Mexico to impose
"economic sanctions" and revoke the visas of the National Electoral Institute
(INE) councilors who unanimously ordered him to stop calling Morena a "narco-
party" and to remove from his social media the posts in which he uses that
label.

"Alito" Moreno Cárdenas has repeatedly turned to the United States to bring
his grievances against the Mexican government. Since February 2025, for
example, he has traveled on various occasions to Washington, where he has
claimed to hold meetings with US political figures and has denounced an
alleged political persecution in Mexico.

"Alito" was in the US capital in August and September of that year—when he met
with Republican congresswoman María Elvira Salazar—and again in February and
May of 2026, when he reiterated his accusations against Morena. Now he once
again turns to the US authorities, this time to request sanctions against INE
councilors.

## "Alito" Calls for Sanctioning the INE

Moreno Cárdenas announced that this Monday he filed a complaint with the
United States Department of State to request that the actions of councilors
Rita Bell López Vences, Frida Denisse Gómez Puga, and Arturo Castillo Loza be
reviewed and that they be sanctioned under the Global Magnitsky Human Rights
Accountability Act.

**" This law allows the United States government to impose economic sanctions
and restrict entry to its territory when certain grounds of serious human
rights violations or corruption are established,"** the PRI leader wrote on
his social media, adding that, as a Senator, he is convinced that freedom of
expression deserves a firm defense.

> Presenté, hace unos momentos, una denuncia ante el Departamento de Estado de
> Estados Unidos para solicitar que se revisen las actuaciones de los
> Consejeros del [@INEMexico](https://x.com/INEMexico?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw)
> Arturo Castillo Loza, Rita Bell López Vences y Frida Denisse Gómez Puga, a
> la luz de la Global Magnitsky…
> [pic.twitter.com/eBi6R5bFYf](https://t.co/eBi6R5bFYf)
>
> -- Alejandro Moreno (@alitomorenoc) [August 10,
> 2026](https://x.com/alitomorenoc/status/2086833700805710055?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw)

**" In July 2025, the United States sanctioned Brazilian judge Alexandre de
Moraes and expressly cited the repression of freedom of expression and the
persecution of political opponents as part of the reasons for the measure. His
visa was also revoked. That precedent shows that the US authorities have
already used their tools to respond to conduct they consider serious
infringements of freedom of expression."**

To support his request for the intervention of the United States government in
Mexico, the PRI leader claimed that the Mexican government wants to silence
his party: **" In the PRI we will not allow the cynics and narco-politicians
of MORENA to finish building a dictatorship under the protection of organized
crime. They will fall, in due time."**

## Washington and the Recurring Visits

Less than three months ago, on May 15, Moreno Cárdenas went to Washington and,
in front of the Capitol, issued a message denouncing the Mexican government
with the same narrative.

**" In the PRI we will not allow the cynics and narco-politicians of MORENA to
finish building a dictatorship under the protection of organized crime,"** he
said on that occasion.

> Les saludo desde Washington DC, en los Estados Unidos, donde tendremos
> reuniones importantes para seguir dando la batalla por la defensa de la
> democracia en México.  
>  
> El PRI es la oposición que defiende la democracia con firmeza, carácter y
> valor, para que México tenga…
> [pic.twitter.com/LNqF3ppecE](https://t.co/LNqF3ppecE)
>
> -- Alejandro Moreno (@alitomorenoc) [May 15,
> 2026](https://x.com/alitomorenoc/status/2055355287272341959?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw)

Earlier, on February 8, he was also in Washington, where he dined with
Christophe Pierre, apostolic nuncio to the United States. **" We had a very
good talk about the challenges Mexico, the United States, and the world face
today,"** he wrote at the time.

> Disfrutamos de una gran cena reunión en Washington, DC, EUA
> ![🇺🇸](https://s.w.org/images/core/emoji/17.0.2/72x72/1f1fa-1f1f8.png), con
> Christophe Pierre, Nuncio Apostólico en los Estados Unidos. Tuvimos una muy
> buena plática sobre los retos que hoy enfrentan México, Estados Unidos y el
> mundo.  
>  
> Hablamos de seguridad regional y hemisférica,…
> [pic.twitter.com/DPpwvw8u7Y](https://t.co/DPpwvw8u7Y)
>
> -- Alejandro Moreno (@alitomorenoc) [February 8,
> 2026](https://x.com/alitomorenoc/status/2020570627506159687?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw)

Last year, after Trump took office as president of the United States, Moreno
Cárdenas also traveled to Washington, D.C. On February 12, 2025, he claimed to
have held private working meetings with leaders who have influence over that
country's decisions. The PRI leadership did not reveal their names but
reported that the meetings addressed topics such as security, migration, the
T-MEC, and the bilateral relationship.

In that context, he again complained that in Mexico there were no conditions
of "democratic normalcy," because, he said, **" for the Morena government its
only reason of State is to consolidate a dictatorship, not peace, not justice,
and much less democracy in our country,"** and he accused the government of
undertaking a political persecution.

> ¡Buenas tardes desde Washington, DC! En reuniones de trabajo privadas para
> abordar temas clave de la relación México-Estados Unidos: seguridad, el
> futuro del T-MEC y el fortalecimiento de nuestra cooperación bilateral.
> Siempre con la visión de defender los intereses del pueblo de…
> [pic.twitter.com/RywBm11dcA](https://t.co/RywBm11dcA)
>
> -- Alejandro Moreno (@alitomorenoc) [February 13,
> 2025](https://x.com/alitomorenoc/status/1889827083813032416?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw)

## "Alito's" Agenda

Then, on Saturday, August 2, 2025, the national president of the PRI went to
Washington again, when that city is normally at a standstill. The PRI leader
sent a video message from a cruise ship and did not attach evidence of the
"extraordinary day of work" he claimed to have carried out.

In the video posted on his X account, he claimed to have had **" very good
meetings"** and boasted of an **" extraordinary day of work,"** although he
did not publicly identify the people he had met with either. In that message
he insisted that the PRI would take its complaints about what was happening in
Mexico to the United States and stated that he would continue working and
denouncing from that country.

> ¡Buen día desde Washington, DC!
> ![🇺🇸](https://s.w.org/images/core/emoji/17.0.2/72x72/1f1fa-1f1f8.png) Hemos
> tenido muy buenas reuniones, vamos avanzando con paso firme. ¡Siempre
> trabajando por la defensa de México!
> ![🇲🇽](https://s.w.org/images/core/emoji/17.0.2/72x72/1f1f2-1f1fd.png)
> [pic.twitter.com/Am2r4BALES](https://t.co/Am2r4BALES)
>
> -- Alejandro Moreno (@alitomorenoc) [August 2,
> 2025](https://x.com/alitomorenoc/status/1951681895856546271?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw)

On August 14, 2025, "Alito" returned to Washington, this time to the
headquarters of the Organization of American States (OAS), where he met with
its secretary general, Albert Ramdin. Accompanied by PRI legislators, he once
again denounced a political persecution in Mexico and questioned the judicial
and electoral reforms. He also spoke about insecurity, freedom of expression,
and the presence of organized crime. The delegation included, among others,
senators Manuel Añorve and Pablo Angulo, Deputy Carlos Gutiérrez Mancilla, and
the PRI's secretary of International Affairs, Sofía Carvajal.

> Durante nuestra reunión en la OEA, denunciamos la persecución política que
> se vive en México, la farsa de la reforma judicial y la reforma electoral
> que pretenden imponer, y que amenazan con destruir la libertad de expresión,
> la vida política del país y los derechos del pueblo.…
> [pic.twitter.com/pEsD9PqSIw](https://t.co/pEsD9PqSIw)
>
> -- Alejandro Moreno (@alitomorenoc) [August 14,
> 2025](https://x.com/alitomorenoc/status/1956070208952787302?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw)

On the night of Wednesday, September 3, 2025, he returned to Washington, where
he spoke, in a hallway, with Republican María Elvira Salazar.

> En Washington D.C.
> ![🇺🇸](https://s.w.org/images/core/emoji/17.0.2/72x72/1f1fa-1f1f8.png)
> seguimos trabajando con toda la determinación por México. Con paso firme y
> en reuniones muy productivas, estamos echados para adelante defendiendo lo
> que de verdad importa: la seguridad hemisférica y una relación bilateral
> sólida que dé resultados en favor…
> [pic.twitter.com/lB8RJ4tnB3](https://t.co/lB8RJ4tnB3)
>
> -- Alejandro Moreno (@alitomorenoc) [September 4,
> 2025](https://x.com/alitomorenoc/status/1963399726566699231?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw)

**" We will never allow a terrorist and communist narco-dictatorship to be
established in Mexico. Our country must remain a nation of Institutions, with
democracy, where human rights, freedoms, and the Constitution are
respected,"** he shared on his X account.

It was also the occasion on which he shared a photograph of himself ironing a
shirt, which gave rise to memes alluding to the Cri-Cri song: **" An old rat
who was an ironing woman."**

### Álvaro Delgado Gómez

    
    
    Álvaro Delgado Gómez is a journalist, born in Lagos de Moreno, Jalisco, in 1966. He began in 1986 as a reporter and has worked in the newsrooms of El Financiero, El Nacional, and El Universal. In November 1994 he joined the weekly Proceso as a reporter, where he was head of Political Information and specialized in covering political affairs. He has written several books, notably _El Yunque, la ultraderecha en el poder_ (Plaza y Janés); _El Ejército de Dios_ (Plaza y Janés); and _El engaño. Prédica y práctica del PAN_ (Grijalbo). _El amasiato. El pacto secreto Peña-Calderón y otras traiciones panistas_ (Editorial Proceso) is his most recent book.
